content_sections.text: Registration Group Discussion (GD) or Written test (if required) Walk-in Interview by Nominated Committee Medical Examination

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KRCL Junior Technical Assistant / Mechanical Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL) for filling up temporary positions on a contract basis in Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in KRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The position offered is Junior Technical Assistant / Mechanical under advertisement number CO/P-R/19C/2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available for the Junior Technical Assistant / Mechanical post across various reservation categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for KRCL Junior Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The mode of application and selection is through a Walk-in interview. Eligible candidates need to report directly to the venue with required documents.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for KRCL recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Technical Assistant / Mechanical position is scheduled to be held on 21-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Full-time Degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized AICTE university or institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for KRCL Junior Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is not more than 40 years as on 01/09/2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging from Rs. 41,380 to Rs. 47,220 depending on Class A, B, and C classifications.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by visiting the official website www.konkanrailway.com or by clicking the direct link provided in the important links section.
